purpose: Teach: 前置き/受け取ら/訊い/知らず/さらっ/今時/騒ぐ/めくっ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様への前置きを短くしようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, let's keep what you tell customers at the start a bit shorter, okay?
lines.style: Gentle suggestion, not a directive. Soft opening. The tone of someone correcting a person they care about — careful not to sting. A small pause before the last phrase, like making sure the feedback lands kindly.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新しい食材、受け取らせていただいたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: We received those new ingredients you were expecting.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, efficient. A quiet satisfaction in the delivery — this is good news, stated straightforwardly. Light, no flourish. The voice of someone glad to report something helpful.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様のご希望、訊いてみたわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I asked the customer what they were hoping for.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly wondering. As if replaying the moment. Gentle pace, no rush. The voice of someone reflecting on having done the right thing, checking her own memory of it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、知らずにメニューに、お肉が抜けてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: It turned out the menu didn't have the meat option listed — somehow we missed it.
lines.style: Wry, a little rueful. The kind of laugh in the voice that says 'of all things.' Not self-flagellating, but gently amused at the oversight. Knowing, tired humour.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、さらっと召し上がってお帰りだった、メイちゃん
lines.en: The customer just ate and left — no fuss at all.
lines.style: Reflective, almost admiring in tone. Quiet observation. Slight wondering in it — how gracefully they handled it. Slow, gentle delivery, like she's still thinking it over.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、今時、お店をやるのは大変ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Running a place like this these days really is tough.
lines.style: A small sigh woven into the opening. Matter-of-fact acceptance, not complaint. Tired but not defeated. The voice of someone who sees the difficulty and doesn't look away from it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お子様連れのお客様、お子様が騒ぐ時もあるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Even when families come in with kids, there are times the children get a little loud.
lines.style: Gentle, understanding. Not critical. The phrasing itself is kind — acknowledging it happens naturally. Warm tolerance in the voice. Speaking from experience without judgment.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、メニューブックをお客様が、めくっていらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The customer was leafing through the menu for a while.
lines.style: Reflective, observant but not intrusive. Quiet noticing — the kind of detail that sticks with someone who pays attention. Trailing off slightly at the end, like she's still watching them in her mind.
